name: time-machine
description: Time Machine pure query engine (W050): assembling point-in-time VIEWS from recorded event/information streams. assembleView is THE GATE: every stream record re-proven through W004's own validateEventStream and W027's own loadInformationDataset validators (errors carried VERBATIM), every stream's declared families/world/time-range proven against the query, then the knowable-at-cutoff records selected through W004's/W027's own observation laws (isEventObservableAt / the publication-time mapping law) and sealed through the tradrl-time-machine contract's knowledge firewall (R016 — a view referencing anything after its cutoff is refused loudly). The deterministic view carries the records in canonical order plus the per-stream summaries as data (W004 EventStreamDigest / W027 InformationImportSummary). fidelity.ts proves the W022-style deterministic-replay laws: the A9 twin (the same view re-assembled twice deep-equals) + the view digest re-derivation. A14: the machine ASSEMBLES views — never executes, never forecasts, never re-scores. W051 (search integrity) and W052 (holdouts) build on it.
